    Harbor City Fire Department

    FIRE STATION1

    One engine, one crew, and a 520×384 city — ten times the old map — that keeps catching fire. Answer the calls, lay hose, send ambulances to the injured, and spend what you earn on more apparatus. Wages and upkeep are due every hour.

    RespondSelect a vehicle (1–8), right-click a fire. It finds the road route.
    DeployThe crew ride along. On scene they dismount and attack.
    WaterThe tank runs dry. Park beside a hydrant and press G to connect, or refill at the station.
    HoseWater only flows within the vehicle's hose range (12–16 tiles).
    RescuePeople still inside show on the building. A crew at the building brings them out before it comes down.
    MedicalPeople hurt in a fire lie on the street on a clock. Send an ambulance; restock its kits at the station or a pharmacy (P).
    ApparatusKnockdowns and rescues pay credits. Press B to buy pumps, ladders, tankers, rescue units or ambulances — and sell them back.

    Controls

    Left click
    Select the engine, a crew member or a building
    Right click
    Send the selected unit there — on a burning building, the engine is dispatched
    Drag
    Pan the map
    Scroll
    Zoom around the pointer
    Arrow keys
    Pan the map
    1 – 8
    Select a vehicle
    Tab
    Jump to the next incident (fire, forest fire or injured person)
    Home
    Jump back to Station 1
    P
    Send the selected ambulance to the nearest pharmacy to restock
    M
    Sound on or off
    Space
    Pause or resume
    D
    Dispatch to the fire that most needs it — an ambulance goes to the nearest patient
    E
    Deploy the crew at the engine
    R
    Pack the crew back up
    G
    Connect or detach the hydrant supply line
    H
    Send the selected engine back to the station
    B
    Apparatus panel — buy another engine with credits
    C
    Center on the selected unit or building
    Esc
    Clear the selection

    A building that burns too long collapses, and every collapse drags the city rating down — but the shift never ends. People trapped inside are marked on the building: a crew at the building brings them out before attacking the fire. Park beside a hydrant and press G to hook up a supply line; the station apron refills too. Knockdowns, rescues and treated patients earn credits; wages and upkeep are paid every game hour out of the city subsidy, which shrinks as the rating falls.
